label: TP
reason: Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is a true positive: user input from query string flows directly into SQL query at line 88 without sanitization (bar variable contains decoded user input concatenated into SQL string). evidence.note: SQL query constructed with unsanitized user input (bar variable derived from request.getParameter) directly concatenated into SQL string - genuine SQL injection vulnerability
